title: TodayWeather for iOS · Forecast ads
scenario: On iPhone, open TodayWeather with saved places. The four native-card captures use a local sample creative in the app’s native ad view; the anchored banner capture shows Google’s test banner. Actual ad artwork, text, and the AdChoices control come from the ad service. Which formats appear is set remotely by the operator.

steps.title: Hourly forecast
steps.instruction: Tap 시간별날씨. Scroll past the hourly forecast chart and the hourly air outlook when it is available.
steps.caption: A compact ad card separates the hourly forecast from the detail cards.
steps.expected: The forecast remains readable and the tab bar stays within reach.

steps.title: Daily forecast
steps.instruction: Tap 일별날씨. Read the multi-day chart, air outlook and daily detail row, then scroll toward the weather data source.
steps.caption: The compact card sits below daily weather details.
steps.expected: Swipe the daily detail row horizontally without opening an ad.

steps.title: Air quality
steps.instruction: Tap 대기정보 and scroll below the current air conditions and hourly air-quality graph.
steps.caption: The compact card appears between the air overview and the remaining data.
steps.expected: The grade, guidance and hourly AQI remain together above the card.

steps.title: Saved places
steps.instruction: Tap 즐겨찾기 and scroll to the end of the saved locations. Enter edit or search mode to manage your places.
steps.caption: A stacked ad card appears after the final visible saved place.
steps.expected: Search, results and editing show only place controls and content.

steps.title: Anchored banner
steps.instruction: When the operator switches the anchored banner on (and the native card off), open any tab. Nothing changes in how you read or navigate.
steps.caption: A Google test banner sits below the tab bar; the hourly page shows no native card.
steps.expected: The tab bar and every page stay usable above the banner. Without a banner, no empty strip remains.
